windowDays.description: Length of the fixed window in days.

from.description: Start of the window: generatedAt minus windowDays. The window holds the terminal product runs created at or after it.

generatedAt.description: When the daemon computed this answer; nothing is stored.

scannedRuns.description: Terminal product runs read inside the window; the sum of every route's runs.

complete.description: True when the scan reached the window start or the end of the retained run records (the engine keeps terminal records for at least thirty days, longer than the window); false when it stopped early.

incompleteReason.description: Why the scan stopped early: scan_bound means the fixed newest-first record bound was reached inside the window, so older runs of the window are not counted. Null when complete.

harnessId.description: Harness of the route: the run's settled route harness, else its failure's harness, else its primary harness, else unknown.

access.description: Effective access profile the engine enforced; unknown when the run recorded none. The retired external_sandbox_full counts as full.

runs.description: Terminal product runs of the route created inside the window; always succeeded + failed + cancelled + other.

cancelled.description: Runs whose lifecycle ended cancelled or interrupted.

other.description: Runs in any other terminal lifecycle.

category.description: Typed failure category shared by every run in the group; unknown when the run left no typed failure record.

anyOf.description: Machine-readable failure sub-code within a RunFailure category, including historical delegated-run failures and active access-profile refusals.

code.description: Failure sub-code shared by the group; null when the failures carried none.

message.description: First line of the failures' display-safe message, redacted and cut to 160 characters; empty when the run left no message.

count.description: Failed runs of the route in this group.

items.description: One group of a route's failed runs, keyed by category, code and message.

topFailures.description: At most three groups of the route's failed runs, most frequent first.

items.description: Outcome counts of one route (harness x effective access) inside the window.

routes.description: Every route with at least one run in the window, sorted by harnessId, then access.

ControlRouteHealth.description: Per-route run outcomes over the last seven days, computed on demand from retained run records. Facts only: no thresholds, no alarms.
